name: Quincy Jones
hook: A jazz trumpeter and arranger who became the producer behind the best-selling album ever made.

blurb.age7: Quincy Jones started out playing jazz trumpet, then became a famous music producer. He helped make Michael Jackson's biggest albums.
blurb.age13: Jones began his career as a jazz trumpeter and arranger in the early 1950s before moving into film scoring and pop production. He produced Michael Jackson's 'Off the Wall' (1979) and 'Thriller' (1982), the best-selling album in history, bringing a jazz arranger's ear for horns and rhythm to mainstream pop.
blurb.adult: Jones's career arc, from big-band jazz arranger to the producer of the best-selling album ever made, is this dataset's clearest jazz-to-pop crossover, and it makes his production work on Jackson's records a genuinely cross-lineage edge rather than a same-genre credit.

signatureTracks.title: Off the Wall (produced for Michael Jackson)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Their first collaboration, and the record where Jackson's adult solo sound first took shape.

signatureTracks.title: Thriller (produced for Michael Jackson)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: The best-selling album ever made, and the clearest large-scale demonstration of Jones's pop production.
